confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Nepal tourist pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain and July is monsoon low season, so rates may be lower than peak-season listings. Wine and cocktail are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page. I did not open that page or confirm the figure against the RBA F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: South Asian lakeside tourist town, priced between Kathmandu's tourist districts and budget guesthouse levels in Nepal. Accommodation is anchored to Pokhara's lakeside guesthouse and hostel market. Alcohol is priced above beer-level relationships because of import duties on wine and spirits.
